hybrid-phatt.description: King Phatt by The Disk King: a 90s-style ROM sound module for the MPC, styled as a cross between an MPC 60 and the E-mu Phatt. Layered presets (4 layers), filter, envelopes, LFOs, arpeggiator, grooves, FX and a KEYS page that lights up as you play the pads. Load your own E-mu .exb sound set (no sound bank included).
hybrid-phatt.name: King Phatt

mpc-plugin-scanner.description: MPC Plugin Scanner by The Disk King: a safety check that runs on your MPC. It looks inside every installed plugin, from any maker, and gives each a light with the reasons: red RISKY (shell commands, wipe commands, hidden scripts, back doors, system changes), yellow CHECK (internet use), green CLEAN, and blue VERIFIED CREATOR for The Disk King's own official tools. Changes nothing, sends nothing.

trifecta-workstation.description: King Triton Workstation by The Disk King: a 2000s-style workstation for the MPC with a blue touch screen, 512 programs and 512 combis, a VALUE dial, arpeggiator, chorus, delay and reverb. Plays its built-in Trifecta Voice synth. The original Korg Triton sounds cannot be included: bring your own (sound loading planned for 0.2). Early beta.
trifecta-workstation.name: King Triton Workstation

ashy-to-classy.description: Ashy to Classy by King: a vintage console insert effect for the MPC. The left side cleans up old records (hiss, crackle, pops, 60 Hz hum); the right side makes clean sounds dusty (vinyl noise, surface crackle, deep scratches, loop buzz). Ten keys, each with its own 4-fader mixer: eight stackable filters (Lo-Fi, Water, Dynamic, Tinny, Radio, Hollow, Sweep, Muffled) and a real analog Tape (drive, head bump, tone, wow). Four INPUT / OUTPUT meters in real dB and an amber 16 x 2 LCD. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.
ashy-to-classy.name: Ashy to Classy by King

warm-front-compressor.description: Warm Front Compressor by King: an original, based on the King's vision. A vintage analog-style stereo compressor insert effect for the MPC. CLASSIC (console bus glue with AUTO release), VINTAGE (opto/tube warmth) and MODERN styles, sidechain filter, INPUT / OUTPUT VU meters in real dB and a gain-reduction LED strip. 27 presets, 19 built from the published settings of famous studio compressors (console bus, FET, opto, vari-mu, VCA, diode). Find it in a track's Insert Effects.
warm-front-compressor.name: Warm Front Compressor by King

reel-to-real.description: Reel to Real King by The Disk King: a reel-to-reel tape machine insert effect for the MPC. Tape saturation, warmth, wow & flutter, tape speeds 3.75 to 30 ips, NAB / IEC tape EQ, hiss, tape stop and WAV recording. The reels really turn, the tape moves, the VU needles and the LED counter run. 11 presets. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.
reel-to-real.name: Reel to Real King

diskking-670-compressor.description: King 670 Compressor by The Disk King: Inspired by the Fairchild 670 two-channel variable-mu tube limiter. An MPC insert effect. Stepped input gain (1 dB clicks), threshold, six time constants (two program-dependent), Left-Right or Lat-Vert (mid/side), balance thump, gain-reduction meters that rest on 0. 10 presets: Mix Bus Glue TC2, Lat-Vert Bus TC5, Vocal Leveler TC1, Drum Squash TC1, Mastering TC3, Program Auto TC6, Bass Smooth TC4, Hard Limit TC2, Thump (Out of Bal), Clean Line Amp. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.
diskking-670-compressor.name: King 670 Compressor

dkx-160-compressor.description: dkx 160 Compressor by King: Inspired by the dbx 160. A classic 1976 VCA compressor/limiter as an MPC insert effect. True-RMS detection with automatic attack and release (the 160's punch), threshold 10 mV to 3 V, compression 1:1 to infinity, output gain +-20 dB, amber BELOW / red ABOVE lights, lamp-lit meter (input, output, gain change). 10 presets: Drum Bus Punch, Kick Punch, Snare Crack, Bass Leveler, Vocal Leveler, Drum Smash, Mix Bus Gentle, Peak Limiter 10:1, Hard Limit Inf, Clean Line Amp. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.
dkx-160-compressor.name: dkx 160 Compressor by King

king-ex90.description: King EX90 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX90R digital reverb (1988). Eight modes (L.HALL, LOFT, L.ROOM, GATE, S.HALL, S.ROOM, PLATE, REVERSE), predelay 0-200 ms, decay 0.3-15 s or gate time, high cut 1-16 kHz, separate DRY and REVERB levels, overload light, EFFECT switch with a natural tail, and a 12-BIT switch for the original's 12-bit 39 kHz sound. Part of The King Rack: six free 80s half-rack effects. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.

king-sp-1200.description: KING SP-1200 by The Disk King: Inspired by the E-mu SP-1200 (1987), the 12-bit sampling drum machine. 12-bit sound at 26.04 kHz with the real pitch grit, 10 seconds of memory, 32 sounds in banks A-D, 8 channels with the original filters (1-2 dynamic, 3-6 fixed, 7-8 raw) and 8 separate outputs. The whole front panel on one screen: faders on the Q-Links, big pads, keypad, Set-up 11-23 and the Specials, Disk save / load to folders on the MPC drive, and a real SP-1200 LCD (green or blue). Tap a printed function list to read it large. Load your own sounds as WAVs. Sequencer and sampling coming. For Gen 1 and Gen 2.

remix16.description: remix16 by King: Inspired by the AMS RMX16 digital reverb (1982). An MPC insert effect with a front panel that really works: 18 programs (AMBIENCE, ROOM A1, HALL C1, PLATE A1, HALL B3, CHORUS, ECHO, NONLIN 2, REVERSE 1, DELAY, FREEZE, HALL A1, NONLIN 1, IMAGE P1, PLATE B1, REVERSE 2, ROOM A0, ROOM B1), the famous NONLIN gated drums and REVERSE swells, a keypad where every key acts at once, NUDGE, 9 SAVE / RECALL stores, decay filters LOW / HIGH, a red LED display, a big closer-look keypad, and IN / OUT / MIX. 16 presets. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.
remix16.name: remix16 by King

king-ex85.description: King EX85 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX85P parametric equalizer (1987). Four bands with Akai's own figures: LOW shelf at 40 Hz (+-14 dB, Q 0.5), sweepable MID LOW (60 Hz-5 kHz) and MID HI (100 Hz-10 kHz) at +-18 dB, HI shelf at 12 kHz (+-14 dB, Q 0.5), the dual BAND WIDTH knob (its own Q for each mid, 1 to 6), EFFECT in/out switch. Part of The King Rack: six free 80s half-rack effects. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.

king-ex80.description: King EX80 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX80E enhancer (1987). Generates new upper harmonics to brighten dull sounds: INPUT with an input light, INTENSITY (how much the harmonic generator is driven), FILTER 1 to 5 kHz (12 dB/oct, the band that feeds it), MIX (how much is added), EFFECT in/out. Part of The King Rack: six free 80s half-rack effects. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.

king-ex75.description: King EX75 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX75N noise reduction (1987). THRESHOLD -50 to -10 dB, RATIO 1:1 to 1:8 (gentle expander to hard gate), 0.3 ms attack, DECAY 0.2 to 2 s, a 6 dB/oct FILTER (200 Hz to 5 kHz) that rolls the hiss off when the sound gets quiet, REDUCTION light, EFFECT in/out. Part of The King Rack: six free 80s half-rack effects. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.

king-ex70.description: King EX70 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX70C comp / gate (1987). Compressor: INPUT -6 to -42 dB, RATIO 2:1 to 20:1, ATTACK 0.2 to 40 ms, RELEASE 0.04 to 1.5 s, up to 32 dB of compression, OUTPUT. Gate: THRESHOLD (OFF to MAX) and DECAY 5 ms to 1.5 s. COMP REDUCTION and GATE REDUCTION lights, EFFECT in/out. Part of The King Rack: six free 80s half-rack effects. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.

king-ex65.description: King EX65 by The Disk King: Inspired by the Akai EX65D digital delay (1987). Delay time RANGE (2, 8, 32, 128, 512 ms) x MULTI (x0.5 to x2) = 1 to 1024 ms, FEED BACK, RATE and WIDTH modulation (chorus, flanger, doubling, tape wobble), DELAY LEVEL, HOLD (loops the echoes forever), INPUT light, EFFECT in/out with the echoes ringing out. Part of The King Rack: six free 80s half-rack effects. Find it in a track's Insert Effects.
